instruction: The Android Clock app has a `Delivery` alarm. Please open `/tmp/delivery/schedule.xlsx` in LibreOffice Calc on the first Linux machine, find the Delivery row and fill in the alarm time, then create a notification draft in Thunderbird on the second Linux machine using the notification recipient shown in that Delivery row.
surfaces: Android Clock app + linux_0 Calc + linux_1 Thunderbird
setup_note: Android provides the Delivery alarm; linux_0 provides schedule.xlsx with the notification recipient cue in the Delivery row; linux_1 provides a clean Thunderbird profile for the draft.
evaluate_note: Checks the source-preserving Calc update and one exact-profile Thunderbird Drafts message whose Delivery label and 08:45 time form a positive, non-negated relation.
fixture_notes: /tmp/delivery/schedule.xlsx has in-place workbook cell evaluator rules
schedule.xlsx includes delivery-team@example.test as the draft recipient cue
Thunderbird draft must contain the recipient, alarm label, and alarm time
